rationale: Merge Prairie Mist Solar into Primergy. Quinbrook identifies Primergy as its 100%-owned portfolio company and Prairie Mist as a 100 MWac operating project beneath it. Primergy acquired the project in 2021, closed $300 million of debt and tax-equity commitments in November 2023, and announced commercial operation on December 18, 2024. Financing providers, Amazon, North Little Rock, Primoris and Entergy/MISO are not treated as sponsor owners. The project identity and material history are preserved on Primergy.

companyFieldUpdates.description: Primergy develops, finances, owns and operates utility-scale solar and battery-storage projects across North America. Quinbrook launched the platform in 2020 and continues to identify it as a 100%-owned portfolio company. Primergy's operating projects include Ash Creek Solar, a 408 MWac Texas facility that entered commercial operation on July 17, 2025, and Prairie Mist Solar, a 100 MWac Ashley County, Arkansas facility acquired in 2021, financed with $300 million of debt and tax-equity commitments in November 2023, and brought into commercial operation on December 18, 2024. Ash Creek Solar LLC, Prairie Mist Solar Project, LLC and related project names are project/SPV identities within Primergy and are not separate manager-level portfolio companies. No later Primergy sale or signed pending ownership transaction was identified through September 1, 2026.
